data.name: Hebba
data.gender_notes: Hebba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hebba is an Arabic name that refers to a young lady or a girl. It is a term of endearment and affection. The name Hebba carries the meaning “Young lady” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hebba usually hope their child will grow to embody young lady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Hebba symbolizes innocence and purity.
data.etymology: Hebba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young lady.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hebba total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: حَبَّة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حَبَّة في اللغة العربية تعني البرق والحبيب والعاطفة والحب. يُعتبر هذا الاسم من أشهر الأسماء في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الحب والتفاني. في الشعر العربي، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للوصف الحب والجمال. في الإسلام، يُعتبر الحب من أهم صفات المؤمنين، حيث يقول اللهsubhanahu wa ta'ala في القرآن الكريم: "وَاعْلَموا أَنَّ فَضلَ أَحِبَّتِكُم مِنكُم" (الروم: 21).

in_urdu.name: حَبَّہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حَبَّہ نام کا مطلب ہے محبوب پیار عقیدہ اور محبت. یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاص اہمیت کا حامل ہے، جہاں یہ محبت اور وفاداری کو ظاہر کرتا ہے. شاعری میں یہ نام محبت اور خوبصورتی کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے. دینی روایات میں محبت ایک اہم عاطفی اور اخلاقی خصوصیت ہے، جیسا کہ کہا جاتا ہے: " اور کہو کہ ہم اپنے محبوبوں سے زیادہ نہیں ہیں" (روم :21).

in_hindi.name: हब्बा
in_hindi.long_meaning: हब्बा नाम का अर्थ है प्रिय, प्रेम, आस्था, प्रेम. इस नाम का उपयोग हिंदुस्तानी मुस्लिम परंपरा में विशेष महत्व के साथ किया जाता है, जहां यह प्रेम और वफादारी को दर्शाता है. उर्दू शायरी में यह नाम प्रेम और सौंदर्य को व्यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है. इस्लामिक परंपराओं में प्रेम एक महत्वपूर्ण भावना और मूल्य है, जैसा कि कहा जाता है: "और कहो कि हम अपने प्रियजनों से ज्यादा नहीं हैं" (रूम: 21).

In Arabic culture, naming a child is considered a significant event, and a name that holds these attributes is an excellent choice for a little girl. The name Hebba is a reminder of the unconditional love between parents and their children, as well as the universal human need to be loved and cherished.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Hebba bint al-Harith was a poetess and a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Hebba carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Hebba bint al-Harith was an Arab woman who lived during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her poetic skills and was a companion of the Prophet. Her poetry often reflected her deep faith and devotion to Allah.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Hebba continues to be used in modern contexts, particularly in the context of Islamic culture and Arabic poetry. It is often used as a given name for girls born into Muslim families, and is also popular among those who appreciate the rich history and traditions of Arabic poetry.
